bio: Tulum beach parties, boho dresses and sunrise sets. Palm shade, white sand and a very good playlist. Adults only.
avatar: Portrait of a radiant woman in her early 30s with long dark wavy hair and a flower behind her ear, wearing a white boho crochet top, Tulum beach at golden hour, shoulders-up, photographic, fictional person, clearly an adult
banner: Ultra-wide panoramic photograph of a Tulum beach party at sunset with palm-thatched cabanas, string lights and adults dancing on white sand far away, subject across the middle band, cinematic

videos.title: Tulum beach party, golden hour
videos.description: White sand, a DJ under palm thatch and adults dancing in boho outfits.
videos.still: Wide cinematic photograph of a Tulum beach party at golden hour with palm-thatched cabanas, a DJ booth, string lights and adults dancing on white sand in boho beach outfits and swimwear, turquoise Caribbean sea behind, tasteful, fictional adults clearly over 25, tasteful, energetic, cinematic, no text
videos.motion: The crowd dances on the white sand, string lights twinkle, waves roll in, camera swoops slowly over the party.

videos.title: Sunrise set on the sand
videos.description: A DJ and a small crowd greeting the first light.
videos.still: Wide photograph of a small beach DJ set at sunrise in Tulum with silhouettes of adults dancing barefoot on white sand and a pink sky, no text
videos.motion: The sky brightens to orange, the silhouettes sway and the waves glow, slow push-in.

videos.title: Boho dress in the shallows
videos.description: A flowing white dress and ankle-deep turquoise water.
videos.still: Vertical photograph of a woman in a flowing white boho dress seen from behind walking in ankle-deep turquoise water at golden hour, tasteful, adult, no text
videos.motion: Her dress and hair flow in the sea breeze as she walks, small waves lap, steady camera follow.

videos.title: Cenote swim
videos.description: Jungle light and a clear freshwater pool.
videos.still: Vertical photograph of a woman in a simple swimsuit seen from behind at the edge of a sunlit cenote with clear emerald water and hanging jungle roots, tasteful, adult, no text
videos.motion: Light shafts move on the emerald water and ripples spread as she steps in, camera rises slowly.
